editorial_note: Rigorous canonical formalization of the Arthitean imperial clan system, meritocratic traditions (Benzshin, Orotion Quests), warfare doctrines (Proxy Wars, Ke'enmon), and the Grand Reincarnation Architecture.

clans.name: Clan Varvadeil
clans.title: The Imperial Logic & Meta-Scientific Hearth
clans.doctrine: Extreme formal deduction, reality-architecture modeling, and outercausal simulation.
clans.role: State administration, mathematical research, and ontological defense governance.

clans.name: Clan Unmatara
clans.title: The Imperial Vanguard & Kinetic Legion
clans.doctrine: Infinitely scaling martial attributes, raw physical dominance, and Imarq fire mastery.
clans.role: Frontline planetary conquest, rapid strike offensives, and martial vanguard command.

clans.name: Clan Redalious
clans.title: The Heavy Military & Fortification Host
clans.doctrine: Absolute defense, indomitable siege warfare, and unyielding tactical stamina.
clans.role: Heavy planetary pacification, causal anchor stabilization, and continental warfare.

clans.name: Clan Vaeloria
clans.title: The Shadow Directorate & Counter-Subversion Directorate
clans.doctrine: Covert surveillance, heresy preemption, and psychological counter-warfare.
clans.role: Internal security, anti-hax intelligence gathering, and shadow state preservation.

clans.name: Clan Venakan
clans.title: The Hyperascender Lineage
clans.doctrine: Massive unyielding competitive pressure injected to disrupt complacency.
clans.role: Catalytic cultural friction, meritocratic pressure generation, and celebratisation.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Entering Benzshin
traditions_and_rituals.definition: The formal clan tradition where noble heirs are stripped of clan luxury and exiled to remote branch clans to conquer the ranking ladder from the bottom purely through suprahard workingness.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: Eliminates nepotism and enforces unyielding individual accomplishment.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Orotion Quests
traditions_and_rituals.definition: The absolute pinnacle of Arthitean progression. When an aspirant conquers a hyperchallenge to exceptional standards, Orotus (the Holy Black Phoenix) directly confers an Orotion Quest with massive biological and spiritual rewards.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: Divine validation and accession to the Apex Royal strata.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Proxy Clan Wars
traditions_and_rituals.definition: Controlled inter-branch military engagements conducted under strict imperial oversight to test strategic doctrine, settle resource disputes, and calibrate warrior potency without risking whole-empire stability.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: Continuous military readiness without civil self-destruction.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Absolute War & Ke'enmon Protocols
traditions_and_rituals.definition: Unrestricted total warfare deployed against existential threats (such as Annaris Deyhamora or Inzra). Involves plunging into the ke'enmon dimension, reality-erasure deployment, and War Factor integration.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: The ultimate state of survival where rules of engagement are abolished.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Grand Reincarnation Architecture
traditions_and_rituals.definition: The supreme spiritual apparatus managed by Scholar-Priestess Qai'lyth that preserves the memories, combat experience, and soul-invariants of fallen Arthiteans across generational cycles.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: Ensures no martial accomplishment or cognitive breakthrough is ever permanently lost.

traditions_and_rituals.name: Venakan Celebratisation
traditions_and_rituals.definition: Grand public festivities commemorating breakthrough achievements in Kafai ranking, celebrating hyperascenders and reinforcing imperial unity.
traditions_and_rituals.significance: Sociological balancing of extreme competitive pressure through collective triumph.

concepts.name: Arthitean Imperial Clan Hierarchy
concepts.title: Arthitean Imperial Clan Hierarchy
concepts.definition: The multi-tier meritocratic lineage structure governing the Top 50 Clans of the Arthitean Empire, balancing absolute imperial sovereignty with lineage autonomy.

concepts.name: Archarthitean Membership
concepts.title: Archarthitean Membership
concepts.definition: Archarthiteans are the clan leaders of the Top 50 Clans and all of their direct descendants.

concepts.name: Benzshin Meritocratic Oaths
concepts.title: Benzshin Meritocratic Oaths
concepts.definition: Sacred contractual oaths binding clan warriors and scholars to higher imperial duties and anti-destiny overaccomplishment.

concepts.name: Orotion Quests
concepts.title: Orotion Quests
concepts.definition: Spiritual and martial trials undertaken in honor of Orotus the Holy Black Phoenix Divine Beast to unlock bloodline blessings.

concepts.name: Cold-War Proxy Warfare Architecture
concepts.title: Cold-War Proxy Warfare Architecture
concepts.definition: The strategic imperial doctrine of sub-existential proxy conflicts, preventing total cosmic annihilation while securing dominance over transadversarial powers.

concepts.name: Ke'enmon Martial Discipline
concepts.title: Ke'enmon Martial Discipline
concepts.definition: High-order combat meditation and reflex synchronization allowing pure-blooded Arthiteans to deploy Melzai and Dasmar under extreme combat pressure.

concepts.name: Grand Reincarnation Architecture
concepts.title: Grand Reincarnation Architecture
concepts.definition: The metaphysical cycle preserving heroic Arthitean souls across parahistory and recursive timelines without memory or capability loss.
